decisions.decision: Use x64-windows-chat-release for both vcpkg target and host triplets in CI.
decisions.rationale: It keeps dynamic CRT/dynamic libraries while building Release only and avoids separate target and host installation trees on the 14 GB runner.

decisions.decision: Keep GateServer, StatusServer, and the single ChatServer target in one heavy CI job, but publish three independent ZIPs.
decisions.rationale: The services share an expensive dependency restore while remaining independent deployment units.

decisions.decision: Cache only vcpkg binary archives after the cache-free build succeeds.
decisions.rationale: Installed trees, buildtrees, packages, intermediates, and release directories remain derived state that CI must recreate and verify.

decisions.decision: Let Qt 6.5.3 MinGW windeployqt auto-detect the Release executable instead of forcing --release.
decisions.rationale: The forced flag incorrectly filters out qwindows.dll; the same Release executable deploys Qt and compiler runtime dependencies successfully when auto-detected.
